reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Filament versus small-gold ATP series, angular-histogram models and drag-based torque; no solution-specific work/free-energy comparison.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.

checks.quote: Rotate a fixed fluorescent filament image computationally
checks.reason: A computational rotation of a static image does not calibrate camera exposure blur, false steps in continuous motion or the actual driven bead orbit. Temporal resolution criteria and bead-center/orbit uncertainty are not validated through a full acquisition-to-event recovery test.

Correct independent-preparation/chamber/molecule hierarchy is present, but the sample-size pilot does not specify a quantitative precision/power target linked to meaningful effect and between-preparation variance.
ATP order is randomized and histogram analysis blinded, but load types/preparations are not balanced across independent days/chambers or concealed for acquisition.

Requiring continuously rotating molecules with >=20 full turns excludes stalled/irregular/inactive motors without an original eligible denominator; active-fraction gates can reject true biological load effects.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

Uniform angular occupancy is not a general continuous-motion null: smooth angle-dependent velocity also creates occupancy peaks. Restricting alternatives to uniform versus three/six peaks risks imposing the desired stepping symmetry.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

checks.quote: each coupled to one ATP turnover event
checks.reason: ATP-dependent dwells and three angular peaks do not establish hydrolysis stoichiometry per step. No same-motor counting or quantitatively corrected ensemble coupling supports the one-ATP and chemical-substep assignments.
No full raw movie/trajectory/calibration manifest with unit identifiers, analysis versions/settings and all excluded/failed records is specified.

checks.quote: rotates continuously when ATP is supplied
checks.reason: The packet supplies rotation, not resolved continuous motion; the repeated attribution of continuity to the supplied observation is unsupported. Detailed proposed choices are otherwise labeled as proposals.
